meta.method: Each brand and retailer below was located by live web search for the maker or seller's own site, then its product page (or, where a page blocked direct fetch, the seller's own listing text as surfaced by the search engine's page index) was read for the exact product name, current price, sizes, colors and material shown there. No price or product name was invented or estimated: where a page would not load, or only a price range rather than a named product was available, that brand was left out rather than guessed. Regular (non-sale) prices are recorded in the price field with any discounted price in salePrice; currency follows the market the retailer sells into (USD, CAD, GBP, EUR or MXN). Brands already in SLATE's catalog (COSTAVANA, R STREET, ABITO, CUBAVERA, TEYA ARTESANAL, P COVALIN, IRELANDSEYE, URBAN ARAN) were skipped. Coverage spans Highland dress and tweed from Scotland, Aran and Donegal knitwear and tweed from Ireland, saris/anarkalis/kurtas/sherwanis/lehengas from Indian-diaspora retailers serving the US, contemporary hanbok from Korea sold in USD, African-print dashikis and dresses from US and UK sellers, Cuban-style guayaberas from a US resort-wear label and from Yucatan makers, modest hijabs and abayas from US and UK brands, First Nations mukluks and moccasins from Canada, an Indigenous Canadian couture label, and Mexican rebozos, huipiles and charro suits from Mexican makers and the government artisan retailer's storefront.
